selection_rule: First PDB listed in immutable earlier 10-domain source manifest; no outcome, no computed model score and no condition-dependent resorting.

fixed_candidate.expected_source_note: External WT only, no mutant source scores; dataset publicly released in 2023 and not prospective blind.

mandatory_before_wt_inference: Verify exact manifest SHA256 and source archive ZIP SHA256 plus published MD5.
Read only frozen label-free manifest and PDB archive member, NOT the measurement CSV.
Reconstruct original PDB ATOM sequence including chain and insertion/gap effects; compare bytewise with exactly frozen 136-aa WT and chain A.
Verify all 20 precommitted single-substitution source and mutation sequence digests, but DO NOT run mutant inference.
Fail closed on ambiguous multimers, chain mismatch, gaps, residue mismatch, ZIP/schema/license or provenance drift.
Use existing isolated local Boltz2 2.2.1 with same predeclared public ColabFold MSA parameters as BBC1, at most one WT structure, no paid Rowan provider.
Freeze input YAML and MSA bytes, checkpoint digest, output confidence JSON, 1D residue pLDDT array and code receipt before exploring any candidate model differences.

hard_science_constraints.source_score_direction_provisionally_doc: FireProtDB negative ΔΔG stabilizing, positive destabilizing; verify each source assay before use
hard_science_constraints.current_permitted_conclusion: Technical input validity only, not transfer/generalization or biological validation.

result_state.reason: Previous remote archival inspection attempt was blocked by security. Do not substitute synthetic unit tests for real source gate.
